items.root_cause: a wrong product reaches a CROWN whenever a brand word satisfies an include and a spelling defeats the exclude (the same shape as the salsa-on-habanero typo), and nothing downstream holds the cell: sanity-check flags it (unverified outlier + unexplained NEW cheapest product) as REVIEW only, and audit-flag-verification (guards) quarantines a flagged cell only after verify-price-flags returns a verdict from a LATER read, so a flag in state 'pending' publishes. The contested detector cannot be the backstop: it saw the Garlic Parmesan variant (two rules match) and not the Cheesy Marinara crown (one rule matches). Measured over the 7 guards files in the 14 days to 09-27: this co-occurrence happened 7 times, 5 of them defects (3 wrong-product incl. today's lemons trash bags, 2 parse-basis incl. today's Hy-Vee coffee and croissants), 2 plausibly real

root_fix.what: teach the existing guard delegate audit-flag-verification.ps1 to QUARANTINE-CELL a crown whose sanity flags for the SAME item include both an unverified outlier and a wow 'unexplained: a NEW price at the cheapest store', while its verify state is pending (no verdict yet); the cell shows its last verified published price with that price's date until verify-price-flags returns 'verified' (then it releases) or a wrong verdict (then it stays quarantined as today)
root_fix.exact_change: in audit-flag-verification.ps1: read the newest out/guards-<date>.json (the sanity flags sanity-check writes) beside the verify ledger; for each board crown (cheapest_store cell) where flags of type 'outlier' (not 'outlier-verified') and type 'wow' with detail matching 'unexplained: a NEW price at the cheapest store' name the same id+store+item and the ledger has no verdict for it, print 'QUARANTINE-CELL <id>|<store>' and exit 2 with 'QUARANTINE-SCOPE complete' (the Get-TcChildQuarantineScope protocol guards.ps1 already scopes at lines 632-637). Do NOT change sanity-check thresholds (OutlierFrac 0.35, WowFrac 0.40) or the breaker. PREMISE TO VERIFY FIRST: I did not read audit-flag-verification.ps1's body; if it cannot see the guards-<date>.json flags or the pending state, put the read in verify-price-flags.ps1's ledger instead and record the deviation
